scenarios.name: normal_operation
scenarios.description: 正常 Private Endpoint 操作场景：创建私有端点 → 查询连接状态 → 列出连接 → 删除
commands: az network private-endpoint create --name test-pe --resource-group test-rg --vnet-name test-vnet --subnet test-subnet --connection-name test-connection --private-connection-resource-id /subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/test-rg/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/teststorage
az network private-endpoint show --name test-pe --resource-group test-rg
az network private-endpoint delete --name test-pe --resource-group test-rg --yes

scenarios.name: partial_failure
scenarios.description: 部分失败场景：私有端点创建成功但查询失败
commands: az network private-endpoint create --name fail-pe --resource-group test-rg --vnet-name test-vnet --subnet test-subnet --connection-name fail-connection --private-connection-resource-id /subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/test-rg/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/failstorage
az network private-endpoint show --name fail-pe --resource-group test-rg

scenarios.name: full_failure
scenarios.description: 完全失败场景：私有端点不存在
commands: az network private-endpoint show --name nonexistent-pe --resource-group test-rg
